description:
Scope/ownership: planning for lib/zaq/engine/incoming_message_routing_rule.ex lines 81, 89, 133. Exclusive test-edit path: test/zaq/engine/incoming_message_routing_test.exs. No production edits, extra test files, or fixtures/support changes in this issue unless a separately approved behavioral change is opened. Public entry points: IncomingMessageRouting.change_rule/2 (read-only), upsert_rule/2 (persisted). Module @moduledoc owns persisted incoming-message routing policy. Test first; no E2E needed (schema/context contract, no new UI journey). Action reuse: not applicable — no executable operation is added/changed; tests exercise the existing change_rule/upsert_rule implementations, not a new Action. Existing command action :upsert_incoming_message_routing_rules and context are unchanged.

Line 81 (String.trim(topic_id) == ""): existing 'blank topic IDs normalize to nil' test at lines 237-249 already sends whitespace to change_rule and asserts nil; 'blank topic command values' lines 709-722 normalizes in command layer before the schema and is NOT evidence for schema line 81. First ask parent to remeasure current line mapping with targeted --cover for the routing test file (do not run full suite/coveralls). If still uncovered, add a specific parameterized/direct changeset case for empty "" and whitespace " \t " with a persisted channel_config fixture from insert_channel_config!/1; assert valid? and get_field(changeset, :topic_id) == nil, then upsert using direct attrs and assert persisted nil/provider-scoped rule, no topic-scoped row. If stale, avoid duplicate tests, record coverage evidence.

Line 89 ({:ok, nonbinary topic_id}): existing test lines 264-276 supplies integer 123 and asserts Ecto cast's 'is invalid'; Ecto.Schema :string cast rejects nonbinary before fetch_change, so normalize_topic_id/1 sees :error (line 91), not {:ok, _}. Establish reachability by reviewing Ecto cast semantics/version and using public change_rule for representative integer, map, list/atom as appropriate, asserting field error and no persisted rule; do not force private normalize_topic_id with fabricated changeset or add production test seam. If no valid :string cast can leave a nonbinary change, mark line 89 structurally unreachable, propose a separate cleanup decision to remove dead branch (outside this tests-only issue), not an artificial coverage test. Do not claim line covered just from a nonstring rejection test.

Line 133 (validate_absent truthy): normalize_destination/1 unconditionally clears configured_agent_id for :none before validate_destination/1 calls validate_absent; :agent calls validate_required; malformed/missing mode uses fallback. A loaded agent-mode rule updated to :none with configured_agent_id set, including explicit nonnil override, should yield nil and successful persisted change. Existing test lines 209-218 covers new-rule normalization; add loaded-row transition via insert_agent!/1, upsert_rule/2, then update to :none with explicit configured_agent_id and assert stored id unchanged, routing_mode :none, configured_agent_id nil (and change_rule changeset valid); assert no agent reference retained. This validates intended observable behavior but cannot run line 133 without bypassing production normalization. Mark line 133 structurally unreachable and request separate production cleanup approval if exact line coverage demanded; never weaken normalizing behavior merely to cover it.

Fixtures/helpers: reuse existing insert_channel_config!/1, insert_agent!/1, errors_on/1 and Zaq.DataCase/Repo; no new shared fixture or Mox. Database sandbox with async:true and unique existing fixture identifiers; one test's DB records do not bleed into another. No global configuration, sleeps, external API calls, or process coordination. If considering a property, invariant is 'any whitespace-only binary topic normalizes to nil' via bounded StreamData whitespace strings (if broad normalization is genuinely in scope); for this 3-line finite branch task, concrete empty/whitespace examples suffice; never generate impossible Ecto internal values. No permission change or nil-identity grant.

Acceptance/validation handoff (parent owns execution): targeted --cover on the exact test file and target source verifies line attribution; run isolated test/zaq/engine/incoming_message_routing_test.exs and mix q via Context Mode; document 81 stale/covered vs missing and 89/133 unreachable with evidence, including any coverage exception. Do not run full suite/coveralls here. No new feature E2E; no docs/production changes. Parent handles final workflow gate only when applicable. Blocker: exact 89/133 line coverage is not achievable via supported public calls; request approval for separate dead-code cleanup if numeric target requires it.
